textbookText: 17. Ramila does not want to get married but wants to be a mother; she is considering conceiving through IVF. Write any one
advantage and one disadvantage of IVF technology.
Ans:- Advantage of IVF Technology: Enables conception for individuals with fertility issues: IVF can help women like
Ramila conceive even if they are unable to get pregnant naturally due to various medical conditions.
Disadvantage of IVF Technology: Higher cost and emotional stress: IVF treatments can be expensive and physically and
emotionally taxing, with no guarantee of success after multiple attempts.
18. We do not fall safely with the help of parachute towards lunar surface, why?
Ans:- We cannot use a parachute to fall safely towards the lunar surface because the Moon has no atmosphere, so there is no
air resistance to slow down the descent.
19. An objects weights 22N in air and 16N in liquid then answer the following questions:
i) What is the upthrust of liquid on the object?
Ans:- The upthrust is equal to the loss in weight.
Upthrust = Weight in air - Weight in liquid
Upthrust = 22 N - 16 N = 6 N
ii) What is the weight of the liquid displaced liquid? Write with calculation.
Ans:- According to Archimedes' principle, the upthrust is equal to the weight of the displaced liquid.
Weight of displaced liquid = Upthrust = 6 N
20. If 2 kg of paraffin needs 4200J of heat to increase its temperature through 10°C. Calculate specific heat capacity of
paraffin.
Ans:- given, Heat energy supplied (Q) = 4200J
Mass of the paraffin (m) = 2kg
Change in temperature (∆𝑇) = 10°C
Specific heat capacity (c) = ?
Now, we know that,
Q = mc∆𝑇
Or, c = 𝑄 𝑚∆𝑇
∴ Specific heat capacity of paraffin is 210J/kg°C.
